content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I'm having trouble with the [product_name] add-in. I switched to a new PC running Office 2016 and installed the [product_name] tool, but I can't see the Add-ins toolbar. Has anyone else encountered this issue? I've seen mention of a newer version of the [product_name] tool, but I'm unable to find a download link. Could someone provide it? Thanks very much.
You can download Version [version_no] of the [product_name] tool from here: [document] Also, check this topic where [user_name] provided useful information... [document]
Hello, It seems that V2.0.0 no longer works. Is there a link to V2.0.1? Thanks.

The download link for V2.0 is no longer working. The reason for this isn't clear; you may need to contact [company_name] for more information. There is also no available download link for V2.0.1. For further assistance, consider submitting a support request to [company_name].
My support request has been submitted.
I have a copy of [product_name] Version 2.00. Hopefully, [company_name] will not object to my contribution here.
I would like a link to download the [product_name] tool.

Hello [user_name], Firstly, welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum. Kindly post your future messages in English. Thanks. You can find the download here: [document]. However, be aware that the software is subject to export restrictions and requires extended registration to download. Why is login and registration required for downloading export-restricted software, and what information is collected?

analysis.insight_summary: Users report issues installing and accessing the [product_name] add-in on new computers with Office 2016, specifically problems with missing or incompatible toolbar integration. There is confusion and frustration around locating compatible versions and working download links for different releases (for example, V2.0, V2.0.0, and V2.0.1). The need for extended registration and export restrictions for downloading the software further complicates the process for users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek seamless, compatible access to the [product_name] add-in for their Office version, a straightforward download and installation experience, and clear integration with Office applications, such as visible Add-ins toolbars.
